items.title_original: Pritzker accused of turning education tax credit into partisan fight by opting out of program: 'Sad to see'
items.summary: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker , a Democrat, is being accused of putting partisan politics over kids' educational needs after he decided to opt out of the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit program, prompting criticism from parents and education advocacy groups. Pritzker announced on Tuesday that his state will not opt into the program, which was signed into law by President Donald Trump last year as part of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. The governor described the program as a school voucher, while advocacy groups argued that he mischaracterized the plan. "At a time when public school education needs investments more than ever, we should not siphon money from public schools for private education – especially as the Trump Administration's policies decimate education," Pritzker said in a statement.

items.summary_original: A Russian warship capsized and sank Sunday after suspected Ukrainian sea drones struck a naval base in eastern Libya, triggering an explosion and fire, according to Libyan officials. Hours later, a second drone attack also hit a commercial ship off the coast of Benghazi, Reuters reported. The first ship, the Russian navy corvette Merkury, was docked at Benghazi Naval Base when two explosive-laden sea drones struck the vessel, according to Libyan military officials who spoke to The Associated Press . UKRAINE POUNDS BLACK SEA FLEET’S ‘LAST MAJOR STRONGHOLD’ WHILE PUTIN FLEXES NAVAL POWER IN PACIFIC At least four other drones were intercepted and destroyed, the officials said. Satellite images showed most of the warship capsized and submerged, with only its bow remaining above water. Smoke could be seen rising from the ship's superstructure, and debris was scattered along the pier. Ten people, including Russian and Libyan nationals, suffered minor injuries in the attack and were receiving treatment in Benghazi, medical sources told Reuters. The warship had stopped at the port to refuel and resupply while returning to Russia under a maritime cooperation agreement with Libya's eastern-based government, officials said in a statement. Libyan military officials said an initial investigation indicated that Ukrainian sea drones had been launched from a base in western Libya , according to The AP.
